messages:
kevin_sales: Prospect asked for the minimal artifact set to sign POC acceptance. Also: can we share the full pen-test report or only a redacted summary? They want answers by EOD.

priya_ps: Minimal set we usually provide: SOC 2 Type II attestation (or signed controls summary), pen-test attestation letter (signed) or a redacted executive summary, UAT/staging network diagram, SSO/SAML test steps + one test account, list of staging IPs or VPN details, and a short POC runbook with on-call contact.

priya_ps: Important: dedicated pricing is not required to start a POC. we can run on shared infra; reserved capacity only if they need guaranteed latency.

samir_security: Pen-test policy TL;DR: default = signed attestation + redacted findings summary. Full reports require NDA + legal sign-off + secure dataroom access. We won't share raw scanner logs or vendor creds.

samir_security: Our attestation includes scope, test date, severity summary, and confirmation that there are no open criticals (or an ETA for remediation of any high issues). We can sign a technical attestation; legal signs contractual addenda.

eve_netops: For quick POC allowlist we provide ephemeral CIDR blocks (2-week window). Example firewall rules they can paste: 203.0.113.16/28 (ingress), 203.0.113.32/30 (callbacks), 203.0.113.45 (admin API). Static public IPs possible but need ~72 hours lead time and may require an ops ticket and affect pricing.

kevin_sales: Can someone craft a one-page checklist I can send? buyer asked: "is network diagram + SSO + pen-test attestation enough for signoff?"

priya_ps: Short answer: usually yes if the pen-test attestation shows no open criticals and SSO is validated end-to-end in staging. One-page checklist suggestion: - SOC 2 Type II attestation OR signed controls summary - Pen-test attestation (signed) OR redacted exec summary (statement of no open criticals + remediation ETA for any high findings) - Network architecture diagram for UAT/staging - SSO/SAML test user validated in staging - Confirmation of staging IP whitelist or VPN details - POC support hours + escalation contact - Optional: KMS/key custody statement if required

samir_security: I'll attach our pen-test attestation template and can redline for their legal. If they press for a full report, ask for CISO/legal contact and reason; we'll prepare NDA + dataroom steps.

kevin_sales: Great — i'll send the checklist and ask whether they want redacted summary vs full report. will capture legal/CISO and loop you if they push for static IPs or reserved pricing. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
